theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cttp_span_ball_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ), ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[n] (ball y ρ ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
